summary: Iteration 97 - Portal User Management CRUD Testing Complete. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Portal Users panel, Add/Edit user dialogs, Reset Password, Delete functionality all working correctly.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 97 tested Portal User Management CRUD. All endpoints working: (1) GET /api/client-portal/users/client-001 returns portal users array, (2) POST /api/client-portal/users/client-001 creates user with temp_password, (3) PUT /api/client-portal/users/client-001/{user_id} updates permissions, (4) POST /api/client-portal/users/client-001/{user_id}/reset-password returns new temp_password, (5) DELETE /api/client-portal/users/client-001/{user_id} removes user. Duplicate email returns 409. Created users can login via POST /api/portal/v2/login. Disabled users are blocked from login. Frontend Portal Users panel shows table with Edit/Reset/Delete actions. Add User dialog has name/email/role/permissions form. Edit User dialog shows current settings pre-filled.

list_portal_users.response: Returns array of portal users without password_hash

created_user_login.response: Created user can login with temp_password

frontend_portal_users_panel.details: Portal Users panel visible when client selected, shows table with Name, Email, Role, Permissions, Status, Actions

frontend_add_user_dialog.details: Add User dialog opens with name/email/password/role/permissions form

frontend_edit_user_dialog.details: Edit User dialog opens with current settings pre-filled (name, role, account active, permissions)

frontend_reset_password.details: Reset Password button shows temp password notification

frontend_delete_user.details: Delete button present in Actions column
